integrity: The stated eigenvalues, polynomial root classification, and lower-dimensional obstruction have mathematical proofs and standalone replay checks; outside independent confirmation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-choice Bayesian design and exact spectral soft minimum only; neither a result about continuous fractional designs nor an algorithmic failure theorem. Classical Laplace-order priority risk remains.
title: Two temperature switches in a three-dimensional Bayesian E-optimal design
